text: Hmph. A face I don’t know.
Most folk keep to the village — wiser, maybe. The mud out here keeps its own counsel.
No one worth a name anymore. I came to the marsh to be forgotten, and it obliged.
Old things. Sunken things. Tread careful where the water goes still.
Hah. Been a long while since anyone asked. ...Aye. Better than rotting in the mud alone. Lead on, then — I’ll make my way to your fire.
Come with me. There’s nothing left for you out here.
